name: awesome-he
desc: ✨ Awesome - A curated list of amazing Homomorphic Encryption libraries, software and resources

resources.name: blyss
resources.desc: Rust FHE library specialized for private information retrieval. Includes bindings to JS & Python.

resources.name: cuFHE
resources.desc: CUDA-accelerated Fully Homomorphic Encryption Library.

resources.name: cuHE
resources.desc: GPU-accelerated HE library for NVIDIA CUDA-Enabled GPUs.

resources.name: Cupcake
resources.desc: Facebook's Rust library for the (additive version of the) Fan-Vercauteren scheme.

resources.name: cuYASHE
resources.desc: Based on leveled fully HE scheme YASHE for GPGPUs.

resources.name: fhEVM
resources.desc: Solidity library that enables confidential smart contracts on the Ethereum VM using FHE.

resources.name: FHEW
resources.desc: A Fully HE library based on _FHEW: Bootstrapping Homomorphic Encryption in less than a second_.

resources.name: FINAL
resources.desc: C++ FHE library based on NTRU and LWE scheme.

resources.name: FV-NFLlib
resources.desc: A header-only library implementing the Fan-Vercauteren scheme.

resources.name: HEAAN-Python
resources.desc: Python binding for the HEANN library.

resources.name: HEMat
resources.desc: C++ implementation of matrix computation (addition, multiplication, and transposition) using HEANN.

resources.name: HEonGPU
resources.desc: CUDA-accelerated FHE library on GPUs (BFV, CKKS, MPC).

resources.name: krypto
resources.desc: C++ implementation of multivariate quadratic FHE.

resources.name: Λ ○ λ
resources.desc: "Lol" Haskell library for ring-based lattice cryptography that supports FHE.

resources.name: libScarab
resources.desc: C library implementing a FHE scheme using large integers.

resources.name: libshe
resources.desc: Symmetric somewhat HE library based on DGHV scheme.

resources.name: LightPHE
resources.desc: A Python wrapping Partially HE library (RSA, ElGamal, Paillier, Damgard-Jurik, Benaloh, and more).

resources.name: NFLlib
resources.desc: NTT-based Fast Lattice library specialized on power-of-two polynomials.

resources.name: node-seal
resources.desc: JavaScript/WebAssembly port of Microsoft SEAL.

resources.name: NuFHE
resources.desc: GPU-accelerated HE library, faster than cuFHE, that implements the tfhe algorithms.

resources.name: petlib
resources.desc: Python library that implements a number of Privacy Enhancing Technologies.

resources.name: PhantomFHE
resources.desc: A CUDA-Accelerated Fully Homomorphic Encryption Library.

resources.name: Pyfhel
resources.desc: A Python wrapper for SEAL, HElib, and PALISADE.

resources.name: python-paillier
resources.desc: Partially HE based on Paillier scheme.

resources.name: SEAL-python
resources.desc: Python binding for the Microsoft SEAL library.

resources.name: SparkFHE
resources.desc: Apache Spark with an add-on for FHE computations. See :page_facing_up:.

resources.name: Sunscreen
resources.desc: Rust compiler for the BFV fully homomorphic encryption scheme.

resources.name: TenSEAL
resources.desc: Library for HE operations on tensors, built on Microsoft SEAL, with a Python API.

resources.name: TFHE-rs
resources.desc: Rust implementation of the TFHE scheme for boolean and integers FHE arithmetics by Zama.

resources.name: ALCHEMY
resources.desc: Haskell-based DSLs and interpreters/compilers, build on top of the lattice crypto library Lol.

resources.name: AWS HE toolkit
resources.desc: Simplifies the process of designing circuits for the CKKS scheme.

resources.name: Cingulata
resources.desc: Compiler toolchain and RTE for running C++ programs over encrypted data.

resources.name: Concrete
resources.desc: TFHE compiler for converting Python programs into FHE equivalents.

resources.name: Concrete-ML
resources.desc: Python-based toolkit for data scientists w/o prior FHE knowledge (using sklearn, pyTorch, XGBoost models).

resources.name: E3
resources.desc: Encrypt-Everything-Everywhere framework for compiling C++ programs with encrypted operands.

resources.name: EVA
resources.desc: A compiler and optimizer for the CKKS scheme (targeting Microsoft SEAL).

resources.name: Google's FHE Repository
resources.desc: A compiler that converts a subset of C++ programs into FHE circuits implemented in various backend libraries (superseded by HEIR).

resources.name: IBM HElayers
resources.desc: IBM's FHE SDK for practical and efficient execution of encrypted workloads.

resources.name: Marble
resources.desc: C++ framework that translates between nearly plaintext-style user programs and FHE computations.

resources.name: SHEEP
resources.desc: HE evaluation platform with a set of native benchmarks and a library agnostic language.

resources.name: T2
resources.desc: A cross compiler and standardized benchmarks for FHE computation that targets lattigo, HElib, PALISADE, Microsoft SEAL, and tfhe.

resources.name: crypto-geofence
resources.desc: Geo-fencing demo application based on Paillier scheme.

resources.name: lattigo-polls
resources.desc: Web-application for scheduling meetings using lattigo.

resources.name: Morfix.io
resources.desc: Web-based UI to play around with the Microsoft SEAL library.

resources.name: nGraph-HE
resources.desc: Deep Learning (DL) with HE through Intel’s DL graph compiler nGraph based on SEAL.

resources.name: OpenFHE demo applications
resources.desc: Several demo applications that demonstrate some of the capabilities of OpenFHE

resources.name: boolean-circuit-evaluator
resources.desc: Demonstration application to read in boolean circuits using multiple formats and execute them in encrypted form based on binfhe module for encrypted boolean logic.

resources.name: genomic-examples
resources.desc: Prototypes for secure genome-wide association studies using homomorphic encryption.

resources.name: logreg-training-examples
resources.desc: Logistic Regression Training Examples.

resources.name: OpenMined
resources.desc: Decentralized data ownership & intelligence based on HE and deep / federated learning.

resources.name: KotlinSyft
resources.desc: Kotlin library for the Android part of the OpenMined's open-source ecosystem.

resources.name: PySyft
resources.desc: Python library for the server/IoT part of the OpenMined's open-source ecosystem.

resources.name: SwiftSyft
resources.desc: Swift library for the iOS part of the OpenMined's open-source ecosystem.

resources.name: syft.js
resources.desc: JavaScript library for the web part of the OpenMined's open-source ecosystem.

resources.name: Rosetta
resources.desc: A privacy-preserving framework based on TensorFlow.

resources.name: tf-encrypted
resources.desc: Bridge between TensorFlow and the Microsoft SEAL library.

resources.name: Zama's Hugging Face spaces
resources.desc: Demo apps showing the power of FHE for real-world use cases.

resources.name: CryptDB
resources.desc: Protecting confidentiality with encrypted query processing.

resources.name: encrypted-mongodb
resources.desc: Wrapper on MongoDB's Python driver that enables to query encrypted data.

resources.name: Prisma/DB
resources.desc: Security layer for relational database systems.

resources.name: TimeCrypt
resources.desc: Encrypted time-series database using homomorphic encryption-based access control.

resources.name: ZeroDB
resources.desc: E2E encrypted database using proxy re-encryption.

resources.name: awesome-mpc
resources.desc: Multi-Party Computation.
